title: Probe suite for quant calibration and regression gating
creator: Aisha Noor
description: Build a modular, automated probe suite that evaluates FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles across model variants and deployment modes. The harness will run a curated 'probe corpus' (golden prompts + adversarial perturbations) and produce deterministic signal used for pass/fail gating of quant calibration jobs. The goal is to detect accuracy regressions introduced by calibration/quantization steps early, provide actionable per-layer sensitivity info, and surface borderline cases for human review. This ticket covers the probe orchestration, metric selection, deterministic replay, and integration with the CI gating pipeline (canary and mainline).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Probe harness can run nightly and on-demand against a given model+profile and produce a standardized JSON report. 2) Report contains: per-prompt similarity (embedding cosine), aggregate semantic AUC, token-level logprob delta summary, and per-layer sensitivity ranking. 3) A pass/fail decision is emitted using configurable thresholds (default: semantic cosine drop > 0.06 OR token-logprob delta median > 0.12 triggers FAIL). 4) Failing cases are uploaded to the calibration dashboard with links to inputs, outputs, and diff artifacts. 5) Integration test in CI demonstrates blocking behavior for a simulated regression with synthetic perturbation.
design_notes: Architecture: lightweight orchestrator service that replays requests to target runtime in deterministic mode (fixed RNG, fixed temperature) -> collector component that stores logits, tokens, embeddings -> comparator that computes metrics against golden references. Golden corpus: 1k curated prompts across verticals (summaries, code, instructions, multi-turn chat), plus 300 adversarial perturbations generated by perturbation runner. Metrics: embedding cosine (OpenAI-style embedding model or internal embedder at same model family), token-logprob delta (median and p95), token-level KL approximation using softmax over logits, and semantic equivalence classifier score. Gating heuristics: weighted rule-based plus a small logistic gating model trained on historical regressions. Determinism: require seeding, disable sampling-specific ops, and strip nondeterministic tokens (timestamps, IDs).
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (this ticket): implement orchestrator & comparator; provide CLI + job spec for model+profile; produce static reports and upload to S3/observability. Phase 2: hook into nightly calibration pipeline and CI gate; implement UI widgets in console (separate PM ticket). Phase 3: iterative tuning of thresholds and add ML-based gating for reducing false positives. Key steps: 1) repo scaffold (probe-runner + comparator), 2) implement deterministic runtime client, 3) metric implementations with unit tests, 4) reporting schema, 5) CI integration PR. Estimated effort: 8 points.
test_plan: Unit tests for metric computations with synthetic logits; integration tests that run the harness against a local dev runtime and a mocked golden store; regression test that injects controlled perturbation to demonstrate gating; bootstrap human-in-the-loop review workflow for borderline failures. Performance test: end-to-end probe run must complete within 45 minutes for full corpus (1k prompts) on a 4-GPU calibration cluster; provide a fast smoke subset (50 prompts) for CI that runs < 10 minutes.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge orchestrator behind feature flag; run nightly on staging models and collect baseline signals for two weeks. 2) Tune thresholds to target ~2% false positive rate on staging. 3) Enable CI blocking on canary jobs for P0 profiles only. 4) After two successful weeks, expand coverage and move gate to mainline for runtime-2.4 release. 5) Communicate to customers via internal release notes and ensure runbook for triage exists.
